law: out_i = int(255*c_i*(A + shadow*(D*max(0,n.l) + S*max(0,r_z)**spec))*L_i), clamped at 255, truncated
law_source: bullet3 TinyRenderer.cpp Shader::fragment; measured and confirmed empirically in examples/results/step7/rocket-landing/findings.md:1209-1217
method: maximise f(n)=A+D*max(0,n.l)+S*max(0,r_z)**2 over a 2001x4001 spherical grid of unit normals, r = 2(n.l)n - l

note_max_is_not_at_n_equals_l.why: the maximum trades a little diffuse for a lot of specular and sits slightly off the light axis
